name: Calder & Voss vendor contract playbook
description: The commercial positions the firm will accept without escalation. Edit this file to change the policy; no code change is needed.

rules.subject: payment_terms_days
rules.message: Payment terms exceed the 45 day maximum the firm accepts.

rules.subject: liability_cap
rules.message: Liability cap is below the $1,000,000 floor required for data engineering suppliers.

rules.subject: auto_renewal_notice_days
rules.message: Auto-renewal notice period is longer than 60 days, which risks an unintended renewal.

rules.subject: governing_law
rules.message: Governing law is outside the approved list.

rules.subject: contract_value
rules.message: No total contract value is stated anywhere in the file.
